sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(p.id) AS player_count FROM team t LEFT JOIN player p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.team_name
SELECT t.location, AVG(p.age) AS avg_player_age FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.location
SELECT t.founded_year, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.founded_year
SELECT t.championship, AVG(p.mvp_awards) AS avg_mvp FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.championship

SELECT p.position, COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) AS titled_team_count FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND t.championship >= 1 GROUP BY p.position

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team t JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, AVG(t.championship) AS avg_titles FROM team t JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, MAX(c.population) AS max_city_population FROM team t JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name
SELECT o.nationality, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team t JOIN owner o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE o.nationality != '' GROUP BY o.nationality
SELECT o.nationality, AVG(t.championship) AS avg_titles FROM team t JOIN owner o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE o.nationality != '' GROUP BY o.nationality

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_player_titles FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT c.city_name, SUM(p.mvp_awards) AS total_mvp FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.mvp_awards >= 1 GROUP BY c.city_name

SELECT c.state_name, MIN(p.draft_pick) AS earliest_pick FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.draft_pick > 0 AND c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name
SELECT o.name, COUNT(p.id) AS player_count FROM owner o LEFT JOIN team t ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) LEFT JOIN player p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY o.name

SELECT o.nationality, AVG(p.age) AS avg_player_age FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE o.nationality != '' GROUP BY o.nationality

SELECT o.name, MAX(p.nba_championships) AS max_player_titles FROM owner o LEFT JOIN team t ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) LEFT JOIN player p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY o.name

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT o.nationality, c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE o.nationality != '' AND c.state_name != '' GROUP BY o.nationality, c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, AVG(p.olympic_gold_medals) AS avg_olympic_golds FROM player p JOIN team t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) JOIN city c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND c.state_name != '' GROUP BY c.state_name
